comment: explode.c engulfer_explosion_msg(), the non-digesting engulfer's disintegration case for a wand (lines 158-163): a Priestess in debug mode raises herself to experience level 20 with #levelchange, wishes for a wand of death, creates a dust vortex with ^G and waits with ms until it engulfs her, then applies the wand and breaks it; do_break_wand() calls explode() while she is engulfed, which reports the vortex overwhelmed by pure energy. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
